name: Sundarajan-Brekke Meridian Overcoat
description:
A single-breasted knee-length overcoat in a wool-cashmere blend, structured with a clean lapel, welt pockets, and a back vent. Sundarajan-Brekke is a Tier 3 to Tier 4 label known for producing quietly excellent versions of classic forms — this overcoat is their flagship, updated each season in new colorways but unchanged in silhouette for twelve years. Current season offers charcoal, camel, a warm rust-brown, and a deep teal. The lining is a printed silk-analog in a small abstract pattern that references traditional ikat weaving from three different cultural traditions simultaneously, which is the kind of thing Sundarajan-Brekke does without calling attention to it.

This is the coat worn by Tier 3 professionals who have arrived at some level of self-possession and Tier 4 individuals who prefer not to signal their wealth loudly. It is well-cut, warm, dignified, and completely unshowy. It works over a suit, a sweater, or jeans. It will last fifteen years with minimal care. The label inside says only 'S-B' in small text.
what_it_says: You have achieved something and you don't feel the need to announce it. You buy quality and keep it for a long time.
worn_by: Tier 4 individuals who find Spire-brand ostentation distasteful
story_hooks: Sundarajan-Brekke's head of design has gone missing — she was working on something that wasn't a coat, and the label's owners are very quietly asking around
A specific run of these overcoats in the teal colorway was produced with a lining sourced from a supplier who has since been linked to forced labor operations on the Shelf
An identical overcoat was found on two different bodies in two different districts on the same night — both victims had no other identification
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions ChemoShield BX-2 Dermal Toxin Barrier Implant

physical_description.visual_profile: A refined, understated silhouette that reads as both contemporary and timeless. Single-breasted, knee-length cut with a structured body that skims without clinging. Clean lapels and a composed stance suggest quiet confidence rather than flash. The back vent creates subtle movement when walking. Wears like inherited quality—the kind of garment that improves with time.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not tight; structured shoulders with a relaxed through-torso and arms. Designed for layering without bulk. Falls to just below the knee with a composed drape. Fits equally well over dress shirts and casual knitwear.
physical_description.primary_material: Wool-cashmere blend in a mid-weight weave—durable enough for daily wear but luxurious to touch. The fabric has a subtle sheen without being reflective.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, closely woven surface with a soft hand. The blend creates a slight nap that catches light subtly. Dense enough to feel substantial and protective.
physical_description.color_scheme: Seasonal rotation: charcoal gray (current default), warm camel, rust-brown, and deep teal. All are muted, natural-leaning tones. Interior lining features a small abstract ikat-inspired pattern blending three cultural weaving traditions in indigo, cream, and terracotta.
physical_description.closures: Single-breasted front with four horn buttons (understated, functional). No magnetic augmentation or tech-integration—pure traditional tailoring.
distinctive_features: Hand-printed silk-analog lining with ikat-inspired abstract pattern referencing three global weaving traditions
Minimalist interior label reading only 'S-B' in small serif text
Twelve-year unchanged silhouette—updated only in seasonal colorways
Structured lapels that maintain their shape
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 to Tier 4—accessible aspirational. Not corpo-luxury, not street salvage. The price point of someone who has built something stable.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by established professionals, mid-level operations managers, independent contractors with steady work, and individuals who value durability over status signaling. The weaving-reference lining subtly communicates global awareness without performative multiculturalism. This is what someone wears when they've stopped needing to prove anything.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; breaks in gracefully over years. Develops a personal patina—slightly softened seams, fabric that settles into the body's contours. A garment that looks *better* at five years than at purchase.
